
## Théorème de Bayes appliqué à des paramètres

$$
\begin{align}
\color{#2E2963}{\underbrace{P(\theta | D)}}   \ \ \ & = & \color{#ED4F33}{\underbrace{P(D | \theta)}}  \ \ \ \ \  & &  \color{#F5B12E}{\underbrace{P(\theta)}}  \ \ \  & / & \color{#ADD2D8}{\underbrace{P(D)}}  \ \  \\
\color{#2E2963}{\textrm{a posteriori}}      & = & \color{#ED4F33}{\textrm{vraisemblance}} & & \color{#F5B12E}{\textrm{a priori}} \ \  & / & \color{#ADD2D8}{\textrm{données}}
\end{align}
$$

. . .

:::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
$\theta$ discret

$\color{#ADD2D8}{P(D)} = \displaystyle\sum_{\theta} \color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)} \color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)}$
:::

:::: {.column width="50%"}
::: fragment
$\theta$ continu

$\color{#ADD2D8}{P(D)} = \int \color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)} \color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)} \textrm{d}\theta$
:::
::::
::::::

## Approximation par grille


1.  Lister un nombre fini de valeurs du/des paramètre(s) $\theta$ à estimer

::: incremental
2.  Leur donner une probabilité a priori $\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)}$

3.  Calculer la vraisemblance $\color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)}$ des données observées pour chacune des valeurs possibles de $\theta$

4.  Faire le produit de la vraisemblance et de l'a priori $\color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)}*\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)}$ pour chaque valeur de $\theta$

5.  La somme de ces produits $\sum_\theta \color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)}*\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)}$ donne la constante de normalisation $\color{#ADD2D8}{P(D)}$

6.  En déduire l'a posteriori $\color{#2E2963}{P(\theta | D)} = \frac{\color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)}*\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)}}{\color{#ADD2D8}{P(D)}}$ pour les valeurs choisies
:::

## Approximation par grille {.smaller}

$n=10$ patients traités, $k=7$ guéris

$\color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)} = P(D=7/10|\theta) = {10\choose 7} \theta^7 (1-\theta)^{3}$

| $\theta$ | $\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)}$ | $\color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)}$ | $\color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)}*\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)}$ | $\color{#2E2963}{P(\theta|D)} = \color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta)}*\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta)} / \color{#ADD2D8}{P(D)}$ |
|--------------:|--------------:|--------------:|--------------:|--------------:|
| 0 % | 1/11=9,1 % | 0,000 % | 0,000000 | 0,000 % |
| ... | ... | ... | ... | ... |
| 70 % | 9,1 % | 26,683 %[^1] | 0,024257 | 29,322 % |
| ... | ... | ... | ... | ... |
| 100 % | 9,1 % | 0,000 % | 0,000000 | 0,000 % |
| Somme | 100 % |  | $\color{#ADD2D8}{P(D)}$ = 0,0827 | 100 % |

: {.striped tbl-colwidths="[10,20,20,25,25]"}

[^1]: Dans R : `dbinom(x=7, size=10, prob=0.7)`

\
Estimateur bayésien de $\theta$ (probabilité de guérison) : $E\left[\color{#2E2963}{P(\theta|D)} \right] = \sum_\theta \theta \color{#2E2963}{P(\theta|D)}$ = 67%

## Approximation par grille dans R {.smaller}

```{r}
#| label: grille
#| echo: true

grille <- data.frame(theta=seq(0, 1, by = 0.1))
grille$P_theta <- 1/nrow(grille)
grille$P_D_sachant_theta <- dbinom(x = 7, size = 10, prob = grille$theta)
grille$C_foisB <- with(grille, P_D_sachant_theta*P_theta)
P_D <- sum(grille$C_foisB)
grille$P_theta_sachant_D <- with(grille, P_D_sachant_theta*P_theta/P_D)
E_P_theta_sachant_D <- sum(with(grille, theta*P_theta_sachant_D))
grille
P_D
E_P_theta_sachant_D
```

## Estimation par lois conjuguées : loi de probabilité bêta

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
$\theta \sim$ beta(a, b), a\>0, b\>0

![](../Bayes_files/img/Rlogo.svg){.no-lightbox width="5%"} `dbeta(x,shape1=a,shape2=b)`

$P(\theta | a, b) = \\ \frac{\Gamma(a+b)}{\Gamma(a)\Gamma(b)} \theta^{a-1} (1-\theta)^{b-1} I_{\left\{ 0\leq \theta \leq 1 \right\}}(\theta)$

$E(\theta) = \frac{a}{a+b}$

Effective sample size = a+b

Si a\>1, b\>1, mode : $\frac{a-1}{a+b-2}$
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| label: ExBeta
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "80%"
x <- data.frame(a=c(0.01,0.5,2,0.5,  1,5,1,2,5),
                b=c(0.01,  1,5,0.5,0.5,2,1,2,5))
taille <- c(20,6)

plotlist <- vector("list", 9)

for (i in 1:9) {
  plotlist[[i]] <- ggplot() + stat_function(color = OrSq, linewidth=2,
                                 fun = dbeta, args = list(shape1=x[i,"a"], shape2=x[i,"b"])) +
     labs(y=expression(paste("P(",theta,"|a,b)")),
          x=expression(theta)) + ylim(0,3) +
     scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2)) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 2.75, color=BlFoSq, size=taille[2], 
           label = paste0("a=", x[i,"a"], ", b=", x[i,"b"]), hjust="left") +
     theme_grey(base_size=taille[1])
}

for (i in c(1,4)) {
  plotlist[[i]] <- plotlist[[i]] + theme(legend.position = "none", 
                                         axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
                                         axis.text.x=element_blank(),
                                         axis.title.x=element_blank())
}

for (i in c(2,3,5,6)) {
  plotlist[[i]] <- plotlist[[i]] + theme(legend.position = "none", 
                                         axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
                                         axis.text.x=element_blank(),
                                         axis.title.x=element_blank(),
                                         axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
                                         axis.text.y=element_blank(),
                                         axis.title.y=element_blank())
}

plotlist[[7]] <- plotlist[[7]] + theme(legend.position = "none")

for (i in c(8,9)) {
  plotlist[[i]] <- plotlist[[i]] + theme(legend.position = "none", 
                                          axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
                                          axis.text.y=element_blank(),
                                          axis.title.y=element_blank())
}

ggarrange(plotlist = plotlist, ncol = 3, nrow = 3)
rm(taille, plotlist, x)
```

## Estimation bayésienne d'une proportion : distribution conjuguée

La loi bêta est *conjuguée* avec une vraisemblance binomiale :

-   $\color{#F5B12E}{P(\theta) \sim \textrm{beta}(a,b)}$

-   $\color{#ED4F33}{P(D|\theta) \sim \textrm{binom}(n,\theta)}$ avec $k$ succès

-   $\color{#2E2963}{P(\theta|D) \sim \textrm{beta}(} \color{#ED4F33}{k}+\color{#F5B12E}{a},\color{#ED4F33}{(n-k)}+\color{#F5B12E}{b}\color{#2E2963}{)}$

. . .

[a posteriori]{#2E2963} : compromis entre [a priori]{style="color:#F5B12E"} et [vraisemblance]{style="color:#ED4F33"}

## Estimation bayésienne d'une proportion : distribution conjuguée

:::::::: columns
::: {.column width="33%"}

               lineend = "round", linejoin = "mitre",
               linewidth = taille[3], color = OrSq, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"))) +

vraisemblance <- ggplot() +

aposteriori <- ggplot() +

  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 0.25, color = BlFoSq, size = taille[2],
           label = "hat(theta)==0.70", hjust = "left", parse = TRUE) + 
  theme_grey(base_size = taille[1]) 

ggarrange(plotlist = list(apriori, vraisemblance, aposteriori), ncol = 1, nrow = 3)

## Intervalles de crédibilité {.smaller}

$(i,s)$ tel que $\theta$ a $(1-\alpha)$ % de chances d'être compris dans l'intervalle

:::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| label: HDI
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "90%"

taille <- c(25, 8, 1.5)

HDIofICDF = function(ICDFname , credMass = 0.95 , tol = 1e-8 , ... ) {
  # Arguments:
  #   ICDFname is R's name for the inverse cumulative density function
  #     of the distribution.
  #   credMass is the desired mass of the HDI region.
  #   tol is passed to R's optimize function.
  # Return value:
  #   Highest density iterval (HDI) limits in a vector.
  # Example of use: For determining HDI of a beta(30,12) distribution, type
  #   HDIofICDF( qbeta , shape1 = 30 , shape2 = 12 )
  #   Notice that the parameters of the ICDFname must be explicitly named;
  #   e.g., HDIofICDF( qbeta , 30 , 12 ) does not work.
  # Adapted and corrected from Greg Snow's TeachingDemos package.
  incredMass =  1.0 - credMass
  intervalWidth = function( lowTailPr , ICDFname , credMass , ... ) {
    ICDFname( credMass + lowTailPr , ... ) - ICDFname( lowTailPr , ... )
  }
  optInfo = optimize( intervalWidth , c( 0 , incredMass ) , ICDFname=ICDFname ,
                      credMass=credMass , tol=tol , ... )
  HDIlowTailPr = optInfo$minimum
  return( c( ICDFname( HDIlowTailPr , ... ) ,
             ICDFname( credMass + HDIlowTailPr , ... ) ) )
}
hdi <- HDIofICDF(qbeta , shape1 = 7+1 , shape2 = 3+1)

beta_shade <- function(a, b, x){
  y <- dbeta(x, shape1 = a, shape2 = b)
  y[x < hdi[1] | x > hdi[2]] <- NA
  return(y)
}

aposteriori <- ggplot() +
  stat_function(color = NA, linewidth=taille[3],
                fun = beta_shade, args = list(a = 7+1, b = 3+1),
                geom = 'area', fill = BlClSq, n = 1001) +
  stat_function(color = BlFoSq, linewidth=taille[3],
                fun = dbeta, args = list(shape1 = 7+1, shape2 = 3+1),
                xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = hdi[1], y = dbeta(hdi[1], 7+1, 3+1) - .1, 
                   xend = hdi[2], yend = dbeta(hdi[1], 7+1, 3+1) - .1),
               lineend = "round", linejoin = "mitre",
               linewidth = taille[3], color = OrSq, 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"), ends = "both")) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(hdi), y = dbeta(hdi[1], 7+1, 3+1), color = BlFoSq, size = taille[2],
           label=paste0("95 % HDI = (", format(hdi[1], nsmall = 2, digits = 2),
                        " ; ", format(hdi[2], nsmall = 2, digits = 2), ")"),
           hjust = "center", vjust = "bottom") + 
  labs(x = expression(theta), y = expression(paste("P(",theta,"|D)"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  theme_grey(base_size=taille[1])
aposteriori
```

```{r}
#| label: ETI
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "90%"

ciq <- qbeta(c(0.025, 0.975), 7+1, 3+1)

beta_shade <- function(a, b, x){
  y <- dbeta(x, shape1=a, shape2 = b)
  y[x > ciq[1] & x < ciq[2]] <- NA
  return(y)
}

aposteriori <- ggplot() +
  stat_function(color = NA, linewidth = taille[3],
                fun = beta_shade, args = list(a = 7+1, b = 3+1),
                geom = 'area', fill = BlClSq, n = 1001,
                xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  stat_function(color = BlFoSq, linewidth = taille[3],
                fun = dbeta, args = list(shape1 = 7+1, shape2 = 3+1),
                xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x =    ciq[1], y =    dbeta(ciq[1], 7+1, 3+1) - .1, 
                   xend = ciq[2], yend = dbeta(ciq[1], 7+1, 3+1) - .1),
               lineend = "round", linejoin = "mitre",
               linewidth = taille[3], color = OrSq, 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"),ends="both")) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(ciq), y = dbeta(ciq[1], 7+1, 3+1), color = BlFoSq, size = taille[2],
           label=paste0("95 % CI = (", format(ciq[1], nsmall=2, digits=2),
                        " ; ", format(ciq[2], nsmall = 2, digits = 2), ")"),
           hjust = "center", vjust = "bottom") + 
  labs(x = expression(theta), y = expression(paste("P(", theta, "|D)"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1 , by = 0.2)) +
  theme_grey(base_size = taille[1])
aposteriori
```
